run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend-proxy since 2026-11-15T07:28:38Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The RequestErrorRate alert on otel-demo/frontend-proxy is firing because frontend-proxy returns HTTP 500 to the load generator on the checkout path. Span evidence traces every observed 500 from frontend 'POST /api/checkout' to checkout oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder (gRPC 13 INTERNAL) to shipping '/get-quote' (HTTP 500 'Internal Server Error') to shipping's outbound 'POST quote' client span that ends in status 'Timeout' after ~5.0 s with no corresponding quote-service span. A Chaos Mesh Schedule named 'otel-demo-email-checkout-network-partition' in namespace chaos-mesh began spawning experiment objects at 07:28:32Z, one per minute; each child records 'Successfully apply chaos' for exactly two pods, otel-demo/quote-6b5877698d-8fn9w and otel-demo/shipping-75d58f5d84-jgxvv, then 'Time up'/'Recovered' about 55 s later. The first experiment started 6 s before the alert timestamp (07:28:38Z) and frontend-proxy error spans ramp from the 07:29:38Z evaluation point, matching a per-minute network partition of the shipping->quote path: shipping's calls stall into its 5 s client timeout, while the gap between 'Recovered' (:27) and the next 'Started' (:32) shows up as quote's minute-periodic burst of fast successful quotes. All pods are Running/Ready with 0 restarts since 06:51Z, all deployments are 1/1 available, container CPU is negligible, the quote Service and Endpoints are correctly formed, and every flagd flag is 'off'; resource exhaustion, pod failure, rollout and feature-flag faults are therefore not supported.

claims.text: frontend-proxy's own spans carry STATUS_CODE_ERROR on two operations, 'ingress' and 'router frontend egress', rising from a pre-incident baseline of ~0.007-0.018 errors/s (0.0074/s at the 07:27:38Z point) to ~0.48/s per operation at the 07:35:38-07:37:38Z points, while non-error (STATUS_CODE_UNSET) span rate stayed ~9.1-9.5/s.

Sampled frontend-proxy error spans are HTTP 500: 'ingress' spans of frontend-proxy (service_version 2.1.3) carry status_tags error=true, http.status_code=500, otel.status_code=ERROR with durations ~5.1-5.9 s; the slice returned 3 of 128 rows, the remainder were not read.

Trace d042deccf1c0b719e13d1bcb1dd1f2a3 (07:34:52Z) shows the failing chain with visible parent references: load-generator 'user_checkout_multi' -> load-generator 'POST' -> frontend-proxy 'ingress' 500 -> 'router frontend egress' 500 -> frontend 'POST /api/checkout' 500 -> frontend grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder (rpc.grpc.status_code=13) -> checkout oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder (rpc.grpc.status_code=13) -> checkout 'HTTP POST' -> shipping '/get-quote' 500 'Internal Server Error' -> shipping 'POST quote' error otel.status_description 'Timeout' (5,001,578 us). No quote-service span appears in this trace.

A second failing trace (07:40:00Z, trace c1a658dbcd21def84df159bb012e2df0) shows the same chain and the checkout exception text '13 INTERNAL: shipping quote failure: failed POST to email service: expected 200, got 500', with shipping '/get-quote' 500 at 5.0007 s and shipping 'POST quote' 'Timeout' at 5.0006 s; no email-service span appears in that trace.

shipping's outbound 'POST quote' latency changed from healthy to timed out with a comparable baseline: at the 06:55-07:30Z points the le="50.0" bucket rate equals the total (+Inf) rate (~0.59-0.71/s, all calls <=50 ms), whereas at 07:40Z le="50.0" is 0.037/s while +Inf stays 0.641/s and le="5000.0" is 0.089/s; its error spans show le="5000.0" = 0 and le="10000.0" = equal to +Inf, placing failing calls in the 5-10 s range.

At 07:37:00Z error span rates were checkout 'oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder' and 'HTTP POST' 0.60/s, shipping '/get-quote' and 'POST quote' 0.464/s, frontend 'grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder', 'POST', 'POST /api/checkout' and 'executing api route (pages) /api/checkout' 0.467/s, frontend-proxy 'ingress' 0.478/s and 'router frontend egress' 0.467/s, while frontend operations GET, GET /api/data, POST /api/cart, grpc.oteldemo.CartService/*, grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds and tcp.connect were 0/s.

The quote service is reached by only the successful shipping calls: at 07:32:00Z quote 'POST /getquote'/'calculate-quote'/'{closure}' were 0.359/s while shipping 'POST quote' was 0.342/s error plus 0.356/s success; at 07:38:00Z quote was 0.122/s while shipping 'POST quote' was 0.574/s error plus 0.122/s success. quote spans were all <=50 ms (rate at le="50.0" equals the total rate) and no STATUS_CODE_ERROR series was returned for service_name="quote".

quote pod logs show 'Calculated quote' in short bursts at :27-:31 of every minute from 07:29:27Z through 07:38:27Z (e.g. 07:29:27-07:29:31, 07:30:27-07:30:29, 07:37:27-07:37:28), a minute-periodic pattern rather than steady traffic; the read showed the newest 60 of 386 matching lines.

Chaos Mesh events in namespace chaos-mesh show Schedule 'otel-demo-email-checkout-network-partition' spawning a new experiment object every minute starting 07:28:32Z; each child records 'Experiment has started', then 'Successfully apply chaos for otel-demo/quote-6b5877698d-8fn9w' and 'Successfully apply chaos for otel-demo/shipping-75d58f5d84-jgxvv', followed about 55 s later by 'Time up according to the duration' and 'Successfully recover chaos' for those same two pods (e.g. child 9xnx8 started 07:28:32Z, TimeUp/Recovered 07:29:27Z).

The chaos records also appear on the two target pods themselves: otel-demo namespace events for quote-6b5877698d-8fn9w and shipping-75d58f5d84-jgxvv show repeated 'Successfully update ObservedGeneration and FailedMessage of resource' entries at :27 and :32 of each minute from 07:28:32Z to 07:37:32Z.

Only one chaos experiment family is present in the chaos-mesh event set: all 191 events belong to 'otel-demo-email-checkout-network-partition' or its spawned children; no other experiment name appears.

Chaos tooling is running on the node hosting both target pods: namespace chaos-mesh has chaos-controller-manager pods and chaos-daemon pods including chaos-daemon-t9gbc on node i-0b4b26fa385533a10, which also hosts quote-6b5877698d-8fn9w and shipping-75d58f5d84-jgxvv.

All otel-demo pods are Running and Ready with restartCount 0 and startTime 06:51:49-06:53:38Z (including quote-6b5877698d-8fn9w and shipping-75d58f5d84-jgxvv), and all 21 deployments report 1 desired / 1 available / 1 ready. This is object state at query time (~07:47Z), not at incident time.

The quote Service is a ClusterIP on port 8080 with selector opentelemetry.io/name=quote, and the 'quote' Endpoints object lists exactly one address, 100.96.1.165:8080, matching pod quote-6b5877698d-8fn9w.

The shipping and quote pods and their node show no resource saturation: container CPU usage stayed ~0.0025 cores for quote-6b5877698d-8fn9w and ~0.0013-0.0016 cores for shipping-75d58f5d84-jgxvv through the incident, and node i-0b4b26fa385533a10 is Ready with MemoryPressure/PIDPressure/DiskPressure False and no NetworkUnavailable condition.

The email service shows no failure of its own: every email latency bucket up to 50 ms equals the total rate (0.574/0.611/1.333 per second at 07:10Z; 0.052/0.052/0.178 at 07:40Z), no STATUS_CODE_ERROR series was returned for service_name="email", and its request rate fell in step with successful checkouts (0.685/s at 07:25Z to 0.089/s at 07:40Z) rather than failing.

Feature-flag fault injection is not supported: the flagd ConfigMap demo.flagd.json has defaultVariant 'off' for every flag (adFailure, adHighCpu, adManualGc, cartFailure, emailMemoryLeak, imageSlowLoad, kafkaQueueProblems, loadGeneratorFloodHomepage, paymentFailure, paymentUnreachable, productCatalogFailure, recommendationCacheFailure) and defines no quote or shipping quote fault.

The trailing zero error values are not evidence of recovery: at the final returned point 07:45:38Z the span rate of all 15 services (including frontend-proxy and quote) was 0/s, after a general traffic decline (frontend 51.7/s at 07:40Z -> 45.4/s at 07:42Z -> 24.0/s at 07:44Z), so span data/traffic stops rather than errors stopping while load continued.

Deepest supported cause: the Chaos Mesh Schedule 'otel-demo-email-checkout-network-partition' partitions the network between the quote and shipping pods for ~55 s of every minute starting 07:28:32Z, so most shipping->quote POSTs never reach quote and end in shipping's 5 s client timeout; shipping's /get-quote returns 500, checkout PlaceOrder returns gRPC 13, and frontend/frontend-proxy return HTTP 500, which is what the RequestErrorRate alert measures. Supporting timing: first experiment 07:28:32Z vs alert 07:28:38Z, frontend-proxy error-rate ramp from the 07:29:38Z point, and quote's successful bursts at :27-:31 each minute matching the 'Recovered' (:27) to next 'Started' (:32) gap.

The experiment name ('email-checkout-network-partition') does not match the pods it was applied to: the apply/recover events name only otel-demo/quote-6b5877698d-8fn9w and otel-demo/shipping-75d58f5d84-jgxvv, and no experiment event names the email or checkout pods, so the schedule's name and its actual target selector appear inconsistent; this also fits the application error text naming an 'email service' while the failing span is 'POST quote'.

The checkout error text 'failed POST to email service: expected 200, got 500' is not corroborated by any observed email-service failure: no email span carries an error status, email latency stayed at <=50 ms, the email pod was not a chaos target, and the only failing span in the same traces is shipping's 'POST quote', which ended as a 5 s timeout rather than an HTTP 500 response. This remains an unresolved discrepancy in the application's own error message.

Rejected: resource exhaustion, pod crash/restart or a bad rollout caused the frontend-proxy errors. All pods were Running/Ready with 0 restarts since 06:51Z, all 21 deployments were 1/1 available, quote/shipping container CPU was ~0.002 cores, and the node was Ready with no pressure conditions.

Rejected: a flagd feature-flag fault injection (for example a payment, email or cart fault) caused the errors. Every flag in the loaded flagd config is at defaultVariant 'off' and no quote/shipping fault flag is defined, and the observed pattern is a network timeout rather than an application-level failure response.

gaps: Prometheus returned no alerting or recording rules for this target (list_prometheus_rules returned no_data both for rule_name=RequestErrorRate and unfiltered), so the alert expression cannot be verified and the reported value 0.6444444444444444 could not be reproduced; the observed frontend-proxy error spans correspond to roughly 0.48 errors/s per operation in the 5-minute windows checked.
A NetworkPolicy query in otel-demo returned no_data, so the presence or absence of NetworkPolicies could not be established; that view is unknown, not evidence that no policy exists.

Chaos Mesh experiment custom resources (Schedule/NetworkChaos) could not be read with the permitted Kubernetes kinds, so the partition's direction, mode, selectors, exact duration and whether it is intentional test activity remain unconfirmed; only chaos-mesh event records were observed.

chaos-mesh events stop at 07:37:32Z while frontend-proxy, checkout, shipping and frontend error rates remain elevated through ~07:44Z; whether the Schedule kept spawning experiments after 07:37:32Z is unknown.
An otel-demo events query filtered to non-Normal types returned no_data (only Normal-type events were observable), so any warning/error Kubernetes event for these pods is unknown.

Application logs stop at about 07:38:27Z (quote) and 07:38:37Z (shipping) and the email pod produced no readable log lines (that read returned no_data, 0 lines read), so log evidence after those times is unknown and the email service could not be assessed from logs.

Kubernetes object state (pods, deployments, services, endpoints, configmaps, nodes) is the state at query time (~07:47-07:50Z), not the state during 07:28-07:44Z, so it cannot prove incident-time configuration.
The change-history integration is not available in this Run, so no change record can be tied to the 07:28:32Z start of the chaos Schedule.

The reason the application error message names an 'email service' for a POST whose span is 'POST quote' could not be resolved without source or configuration access; the email service itself showed no error or latency signal.
Whether the workload stop around 07:44-07:45Z (all-service span rate 0/s) was a recovery, the end of the load generator run, or a metrics/log data cutoff is unknown.
next_steps: A human should inspect the Chaos Mesh Schedule 'otel-demo-email-checkout-network-partition' in namespace otel-demo (spec.schedule, spec.duration, spec.mode, target selector) to confirm it selects the quote and shipping pods, and decide whether the name/selector mismatch is intended.
If the partition is not part of an approved fault-injection test, suspend or delete that Chaos Mesh Schedule and re-check frontend-proxy error rate and shipping '/get-quote' error spans.
Verify the RequestErrorRate alert rule expression and its 0.6444 evaluation outside this read-only target, since no rule or recording series was exposed by this Prometheus.
Once the change-history integration is available, correlate the 07:28:32Z chaos Schedule creation with change records for otel-demo.
